name: evidence.list
title: List evidence
summary: Evidence records of an element with version, item, date, result, evidence location and baselines that contain the version.

view.description: `core`: only the records without a variant; a variant: only the records for that variant (SR-047 AK1, AK2), and also those without a variant when the element's repository is marked `variant-independent` (SR-173); absent: every record of the element.

repository.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: the workspace name of its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it (for example one copy of a file whose UUID another file shares, SR-088; ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#255). Only the elements ref names count; when none of them lies there, the error is ref.unknown with them as details.candidates.

file.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: its file, relative to its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#255). Give repository too when the same path is in several repositories; when several elements are still left, the error is ref.ambiguous with them.

records.description: The evidence records of the element (SR-028, SR-093), newest first, each with its version, item, date, result and evidence (SR-032 AK1) and the baselines that contain its version (`baselines`, SR-032 AK2; empty when none does).

bearing.description: The positions in `records` (from 0, ascending) of the records that bear the element's status (SR-032 AK3): per kind, variant and acceptance criterion (D-072) every record with the newest date of the current version, else every one with the newest date of an older version, so the whole run of a CI stays open; a record without criteria counts for every criterion (SR-031 AK6). In a repository marked `variant-independent` (SR-173) a variant's records are pooled with those without variant, as its status pools them. The app shows these open and folds the others away.

display.description: The Evidence section at a glance (SR-032 AK3 to AK5), computed in core so every access gives the same: the values the bearing records share, one row per acceptance criterion (and one for the validation), and the other records by run.

shared.description: AK5: each of date, item, version and baselines that every bearing record has with the same value (a date as the same instant, the first record's text); left out otherwise.

item.description: The item under test that every shown record names.

baselines.description: The baselines every shown record names, in the same order.

rows.description: AK4: with a verification record, one row per acceptance criterion 1..n (one without `criterion` for a requirement without criteria); with a validation record of a need or a requirement, one validation row after them (SR-038 AK5).

items.description: One line of the Evidence section (SR-032 AK4): an acceptance criterion, the whole requirement without criteria, or the validation.

kind.description: Whether the row shows verification or validation records.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion, counted from 1; left out for a requirement without criteria and for the validation row.

status.description: Verification: the worst status of `views` (failed before outdated before open before verified). Validation: the validation status (SR-038).

views.description: Verification only: the status of the criterion in each view the element applies in (SR-031, SR-047; with `view`, that view alone), the core first; the app names those whose status is the row's. While the metamodel is not valid the status shows every requirement open, but these statuses still compare the records.

cases.description: The bearing records of the row (those naming the criterion or none, SR-031 AK6) by test case: worst result first, then class name, then name in code-unit order, records without test case last in their order.

items.description: The bearing records of a row that form one test case (`testCase` and `className`, ADR-0012), or one record without test case.

testCase.description: The test case's name; left out for a record without test case.

className.description: The JUnit class name; left out for a Markdown record or a record without test case.

result.description: The worst result of its records: failed before inconclusive before passed.

views.description: The views its records hold for: `core` for a record without variant, else the variant's UUID; `core` first, then the UUIDs in code-unit order.

records.description: Its records, positions in `records`, in their order.

older.description: AK3: the records outside `bearing` by run (the same date as an instant and the same version), newest first, then version in code-unit order. Records that name only criteria beyond the count bear nothing and are here.

records.description: Its records, positions in `records`, in their order.

testCases.description: The test cases that name the element (SR-033), by class name, then name, each with the element's own records only, newest first, and every kind of record as in `records`; with `view` only the executions that hold in it, and a test case all of whose executions hold in another view is left out (a test case that was only skipped stays, `executed` false).

problems.description: Findings in the baseline files (`baseline.invalid`, `file.invalid-yaml`, ...): a baseline file that cannot be read names no baseline in `baselines`.

incomplete.description: True when an evidence location or the baselines folder lies in a repository that is not on this machine: records or baselines there are not seen (SR-006 AK2).
